authority: proposal; no runtime deployment or automatic synchronization claimed
core_invariant: Many media projections reference one versioned work/evidence identity; projections never certify their own sources
invariants: A render, narration or diagram is not source evidence by itself
Transformation preserves work identity and source references
Cross-surface update requires version comparison and invalidation of stale projections
Private custody cannot become public by traversal or embedding
Conflicting observations remain separate until independently adjudicated
Every active or sleeping front retains a next trigger or retirement reason
A sender draft is not sent, and sent is not delivered or replied
Public graphs contain no real recipient addresses or private message bodies

silo_modes.intentional_boundary: privacy, safety, independent challenge, least privilege
silo_modes.accidental_silo: unlinked representations or work without discoverable provenance
silo_modes.inverse_operation: permissioned discovery and typed cross-reference, not unrestricted data merger

next_qualification: Implement permissioned graph validator and prove stale-diagram and stale-draft invalidation against changed evidence
